title: Studiolo: the tarot games of the 1787 Turin rulebook
description: Machine-readable and plain-English rules of the tarot card games of the Turin rulebook «Primi elementi e regole del giuoco de' tarocchi» (Torino, Soffietti, 1787). Every rule carries its source, its page and a mark: documented, our reading, or sources silent. With the journal of revisions, the list of open questions and the method.
